description: 132 illustrative lesson briefs across nine internal course subdivisions. Outcomes are original design targets informed by CEFR, not official descriptor quotations or proof of certification. Level specialists must verify sequence, depth and mappings before authoring or release.

outcomes.canDo: Recognize essential details in a short, clearly spoken everyday exchange.
Understand a short everyday notice or personal message.
Write a brief personal message or complete basic information.
Take part in a simple personal exchange with support.
Follow the main details of a routine service or personal conversation.
Find relevant information in a straightforward everyday text.
Write a connected short message about a routine need or past event.
Manage a routine exchange and explain a simple plan or experience.
Follow the main points and reasons in clear familiar-topic speech.
Understand connected everyday or workplace texts and their main arguments.
Write a connected account or request with relevant reasons.
Sustain a familiar-topic discussion and respond to follow-up questions.
Follow detailed discussion, contrasting positions and supporting evidence.
Interpret a complex factual or argumentative text and compare viewpoints.
Write a detailed, structured argument with relevant supporting evidence.
Explain and defend a position while responding to counterarguments.
Interpret stance, implication and discourse structure in demanding speech.
Analyze complex texts, implicit meaning and rhetorical organization.
Write a precise, coherent text adapted to an academic or professional audience.
Communicate flexibly and fluently on complex issues with appropriate register.
Interpret subtle implications, irony and stylistic shifts in demanding speech.
Critically interpret nuanced language and synthesize challenging texts.
Produce and revise sophisticated synthesis with precise style and meaning.
Discuss demanding issues spontaneously with precise nuance and reformulation.
